text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Four-member Gulf Arab mediation committee holds fourth meeting in Jeddah without inviting Bahrain and Qatar, which are locked in a territorial dispute.
- Bahrain Telecommunications Company (Batelco) signs memorandum of understanding with United Arab Emirates Telecommunications Corp (Etisalat) to boost coordination.
- Government asks National Bank of Bahrain to arrange $520 million loan to finance a power and water project.
- Aluminum Bahrain plans to raise production capacity to 500,000 tonnes this year.
- Bahrain Insurance Company posts 876,000 dinar net profit in 1996, raises paid-up capital to three million dinars.
